_comment_guide: To change the license type for a device, update the 'prefix' and 'type' fields for its Device ID in 'paid_devices'.

option_1_single_lifetime.description: Permanent unexpiring license for this single machine

option_2_multinode_5_lifetime.description: Master Hub license allowing up to 5 concurrent cashier counters/tablets

option_3_multinode_10_lifetime.description: Master Hub license allowing up to 10 concurrent cashier counters/tablets

option_4_multinode_unlimited_lifetime.description: Master Hub license allowing unlimited satellite cashier counters

option_5_single_yearly.description: Annual renewal key for 1 counter. Format: Y + YY + MM (e.g. Y2708 = 2027 Aug)

option_6_multinode_yearly.description: Annual renewal key for up to 5 counters. Format: MNY + YY + MM
